bodies.name: Mayor's Commission on People with Disabilities
bodies.about: Advises the City on policies and programs for Disabled Philadelphians. Meets every other month.
bodies.note: Nico Meyering chairs this Commission and scored it first, using the same rules as every other body. Its public page currently documents almost none of these practices.

agenda.finding: The Commission's page lists no meeting schedule or agendas.

remote.finding: Not described in the materials reviewed.

written.finding: A contact is listed for comments, questions, and concerns, but not for meeting testimony.

captions.finding: Not described in the materials reviewed.

asl.finding: Not described in the materials reviewed.

contact.finding: The Office for People with Disabilities lists ADA.Request@phila.gov and a Commission contact, but no meeting-specific accommodation instructions or deadline.

venue.finding: Not described in the materials reviewed.

recording.finding: Not described in the materials reviewed.

materials.finding: No agendas are published to check.

bodies.name: City Council
bodies.about: Philadelphia's legislature. Stated meetings take public comment on bills and resolutions on the agenda.

agenda.finding: Agendas are published in the Legislative Information Center; how far ahead was not verified.

remote.finding: The public comment page describes in-person and advance sign-up only. A remote-meeting notice appears only in the page's older metadata.

written.finding: Comments emailed by 3 p.m. the day before become part of the record, though they are not read aloud.

captions.finding: No live captioning of sessions is described.

asl.finding: Council's 2026 Language Access Plan says ASL interpreters may be ordered through its Language Access Coordinator in advance.

contact.finding: Speakers are told to tell the Chief Clerk's Office about accommodations when signing up, and the Language Access Coordinator's contact is published.

venue.finding: Not described in the materials reviewed.

recording.finding: Sessions air live on PHLgovTV, and transcripts are available through the Legislative Information Center. An on-demand video archive is not described.

materials.finding: Agendas and minutes are published as web pages in the Legislative Information Center.

bodies.name: Board of Education
bodies.about: Governs the School District of Philadelphia.

agenda.finding: Action items are posted with the agenda “generally 3 weeks in advance.”

remote.finding: Registered speakers may take part in person or remotely.

written.finding: The Board accepts unlimited written testimony submitted on time by email or online form.

captions.finding: Not described in the materials reviewed.

asl.finding: Translation can be requested by 4 p.m. the business day before, but ASL is not mentioned.

contact.finding: The page links to an accommodations section on the District's contact page; no meeting-specific contact or deadline.

venue.finding: The address, 440 N. Broad Street, is given without access details.

recording.finding: Meetings are livestreamed, on cable, and archived back to 2015.
